title: Context Schema
description: Information required to interpret objects, assertions, and actions (Vol 1 §16). Context carries a trust level: CONTEXT_HINT is potentially-useful-but-UNTRUSTED information (e.g. an agent passing prior conversation to another agent) - CONTEXT_HINT != ASSERTION != TRUSTED_CONTEXT (Vol 1 §17). A hint MUST therefore hold an agent-writable status (it cannot be authoritative); promotion to trusted context requires explicit justification (Vol 1 §18). This is the type behind the reduced-trust handoff in DECISION-DEPLOYMENT-UPDATE-MODEL-001. Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4.

trust_level.description: hint = untrusted (must be agent-writable); assertion = claimed; trusted = validated with justification.

purpose.description: why this context exists / how it should be used.
